definitions: In any location, regardless of distance; everywhere.
Concerning matters both distant and local.
examples: The company's influence is felt whether far afield or close to home.
We need to consider the impact of this policy whether far afield or close to home.
Her curiosity extends to all topics, whether far afield or close to home.
lemma: whether far afield or close to home
